phrases.english: 1.O God, You created me without fault,
2.nurtured me when small, and provided me with sufficiency.

phrases.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ إنِّي وَجَدْتُ فِيمَا أَنْزَلْتَ  مِنْ كِتَابِكَ،
phrases.english: 3.O God, I found in the Book which You sent down
4.and through which You gave good news to Your servants,

phrases.arabic: أَنْ قُلْتَ: (يا عِبَادِيَ الَّذِينَ أَسْرَفُوا عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ
phrases.english: 5.that You said, O My servants who hare been prodigal against yourselves,

phrases.arabic: لاَ تَقْنَطُوا مِنْ رَحْمَةِ اللهِ إنَّ اللهَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعاً)
phrases.english: 6.do not despair of God's mercy, surely God forgives all sins,

phrases.arabic: وَقَدْ تَقَدَّمَ مِنِّي مَا قَدْ عَلِمْتَ،
phrases.english: 7.but there has gone ahead from me what You knowest
8.(and of which You knowest more than I)!

phrases.arabic: فَيَا سَوْأَتا مِمَّا أَحْصَاهُ عَلَيَّ كِتَابُكَ،
phrases.english: 9.O the shame of what Your Book has counted against me!

phrases.arabic: فَلَوْلاَ الْمَوَاقِفُ الَّتِي أُؤَمِّلُ مِنْ عَفْوِكَ
phrases.english: 10.Were it not for the places where I expectantly hope for Your pardon,

phrases.arabic: الَّذِي شَمِلَ  كُلَّ شَيْء لاَلْقَيْتُ بِيَدِي،
phrases.english: 11.which enfolds all things, I would have thrown myself down [in despair]!
12.Were anyone able to flee from his Lord,

phrases.arabic: مِنْ رَبِّهِ لَكُنْتُ أَنَا أَحَقُّ بِالهَرَبِ،
phrases.english: 13.I would be the most obligated to flee from You!

phrases.arabic: وَأَنْتَ لاَ تَخْفَى عَلَيْكَ خَافِيَةٌ فِي الاَرْضِ
phrases.english: 14.But not a secret in earth and heaven is concealed from You,

phrases.arabic: وَلاَ فِي السَّمَآءِ إلاَّ أَتَيْتَ بِهَا،
phrases.english: 15.except that You bringest it.

phrases.arabic: وَكَفى بِكَ جَازِياً، وَكَفى بِكَ حَسِيباً.
phrases.english: 16.You sufficest as a recompenser! You sufficest as a reckoner!

phrases.arabic: أللَّهُمَّ إنَّكَ طَالِبِي إنْ أَنَا هَرَبْتُ،
phrases.english: 17.O God, surely You wouldst seek me if I flee
18.and catch me if I run.

phrases.arabic: فَهَا أَنَا ذَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْكَ خَاضِعٌ ذَلِيلٌ رَاغِمٌ،
phrases.english: 19.So here I am before You, abject, lowly, abased.
20.If You chastisest me, I am worthy of that,
21.and it would be, my Lord, an act of justice from You.

phrases.arabic: وَإنْ تَعْفُ  عَنِّي فَقَدِيماً شَمَلَنِي عَفْوُكَ،
phrases.english: 22.But if You pardonest me, anciently has Your pardon enfolded me
23.and Your well-being garmented me!
24.So I ask You, O God, by Your names stored in Your treasury
25.and Your splendour masked by the veils!
26.If You hast no mercy upon this anxious soul
27.and these uneasy, decaying bones -
28.he cannot endure the heat of Your sun,
29.so how can he endure the heat of Your Fire?
30.He cannot endure the sound of Your thunder,
31.so how can he endure the sound of Your wrath?

phrases.arabic: فَارْحَمْنِي اللَّهُمَّ فَإنِّي امْرُؤٌ حَقِيرٌ، وَخَطَرِي يَسِيرٌ،
phrases.english: 32.So have mercy upon me, O God, for I am a vile man and my worth is little.

phrases.arabic: وَلَيْسَ عَذَابِي مِمَّا يَزِيدُ فِي مُلْكِكَ مِثْقَالَ ذَرَّة،
phrases.english: 33.Chastising me will not add the weight of a dust mote to Your kingdom.

phrases.arabic: وَلَوْ أَنَّ عَذَابِي مِمَّا يَزِيدُ فِي مُلْكِكَ
phrases.english: 34.Were chastising me something that would add to Your kingdom,
35.I would ask You for patience to bear it
36.and would love for it to belong to You;
37.but Your authority, my God, is mightier,

phrases.arabic: وَمُلْكُكَ أَدْوَمُ مِنْ أَنْ تَزِيـدَ فِيْهِ  طَاعَةُ الْمُطِيعِينَ،
phrases.english: 38.and Your kingdom more lasting, than that the obedience of the obeyers should increase it
39.or the disobedience of the sinners diminish it!
40.So have mercy upon me, O Most Merciful of the merciful!

phrases.arabic: وَتَجاوَزْ عَنِّي يا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَالإكْرَامِ،
phrases.english: 41.Show me forbearance, O Possessor of majesty and munificence!

phrases.arabic: وَتُبْ عَلَيَّ إنَّكَ أَنْتَ التَّوَّابُ الرَّحِيمُ.
phrases.english: 42.And turn toward me, Surely You art Ever-turning, All-compassionate!
